extensions.source: packages/tokens/src (primitives.css, semantic.css, theme.css generated from source/thrive.blueprint.json; supplement.css hand-written). Frontmatter values are the light mode; `dark` below is the data-theme='dark' mode of the same semantic name.

derivedColors.name: action surface
derivedColors.purpose: Outlined button fill, current nav item, tag pill ground.

derivedColors.name: feed card ground
derivedColors.purpose: The 8% hue ground of a Home card by kind.

derivedColors.name: glass
derivedColors.value: color-mix(in oklch, primary-100 65%, transparent); neutral: neutral-50 72%
derivedColors.purpose: Navbars, the Member frame (tinted) and Card (neutral).

derivedColors.name: paper tone
derivedColors.value: color-mix(in oklch, status-{warning|success}-border 10%, transparent); blush error-border 8%
derivedColors.purpose: Postcard and envelope stock tints: cream, sage, blush.

display.purpose: Page-level statements. 3rem phone, 3.4375rem at 48rem, 4rem at 64rem. Cooper ships only SemiBold; 700 renders it with font-synthesis-weight: none.

headline.purpose: A standalone page's heading, such as the 404.

quote.purpose: A quoted line in the display face.

body-small.purpose: Secondary lines, link rows, card descriptions.

button.purpose: Button sm/md; lg uses button-md (1rem). Buttons fix line height at 1.25rem.

overline.purpose: Uppercase field or nav-group label, never a kicker.

handwrite.purpose: Margin notes (lg), a written address, a card's large handwriting.

shadows.name: elevation-low
shadows.value: 0 0.0625rem 0.0625rem 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--neutral-950) 10%, transparent), 0 0.125rem 0.5rem 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--neutral-950) 10%, transparent)

shadows.name: elevation-med
shadows.value: 0 0.0625rem 0.125rem 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--neutral-950) 10%, transparent), 0 0.125rem 0.75rem 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--neutral-950) 10%, transparent)

shadows.name: elevation-high
shadows.value: 0 0.125rem 0.125rem 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--neutral-950) 10%, transparent), 0 0.5rem 1.5rem 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--neutral-950) 10%, transparent)

shadows.name: paper-lift
shadows.value: filter: drop-shadow(0 0.0625rem 0.0625rem var(--surface-scrim)) x2, drop-shadow(0 0.125rem 0.375rem var(--surface-scrim)) x2
shadows.purpose: A stamp or sticker lying on paper; follows its perforated edge (postcard.module.css .lift).

materials.name: scrim-blur
materials.purpose: Page behind a dialog; behind a card being written.

materials.name: dot-grid
materials.value: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in oklch, var(--fg-primary) 4%, transparent) 0.0625rem, transparent 0.09375rem) at 0.75rem

motion.name: duration-quick
motion.purpose: Default transition; overlay exit; postcard turn-out.

motion.name: duration-very-slow
motion.purpose: Postmark strike, handwriting write-on in a dialog, letter flight.

motion.name: scroll-linked
motion.purpose: Orb drift, handwriting write-on, navbar frost; no duration. Off under reduced motion.

narrative.overview:
Thrive's world is correspondence. Feedback is written on postcard stock, stamped, postmarked in worn blue rubber-stamp ink and sent by airmail; people leave notes to each other in the margin in their own hand. The product itself speaks in a calm sans (Google Sans) and a warm, rounded serif display (Cooper) for the moments a page has something to say. Everything sits on a white page that, before a person signs in, has soft orbs of the three product colours drifting behind it; once signed in, the page is held in a frame of brand-tinted frosted glass.

Density is moderate and list-first: Home, Received and Given are columns of tinted cards, Settings is stacked bordered cards of divided rows. Colour is meaning, not decoration: three hues each own one kind of act (giving, asking, thanking/the human voice), and statuses are coloured words inside a sentence rather than badges beside it. Motion is physical and sparse: a postcard turns over, a postmark strikes, a letter flies off; handwriting writes itself on as it scrolls into view; all of it collapses to an instant under reduced motion.

The system is generated. Every colour, size, radius, shadow and corner is a token in `packages/tokens`, exported from the design blueprint; light and dark are two modes of the same semantic names, switched by `data-theme` on `<html>`. Components reference semantic roles only.
keyCharacteristics: Three meaning-bearing hues: plum for the product and giving, blue for anything asked, orange for the human voice.
Paper objects (postcards, envelopes, stamps, postmarks) as the signature material, on white or frosted glass.
Cooper display for headings and stamped words; Google Sans for everything read; Caveat handwriting for people's asides.
Status said as a coloured word in the line, never as colour alone.
Light and dark as token modes; no per-component dark overrides.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Plum is the product speaking and Feedback given unasked; blue is anything asked, and every #hashtag; orange is a person speaking: @mentions, handwriting, Kudos. Never swap them, and never add a fourth hue for meaning.

rules.name: The Status Is a Word Rule
rules.body: A status is a word in its `-active` colour inside the line it belongs to ("2 answered, 1 pending"), set at weight 500. The `-fg` shades are only for text on that status's own tinted surface.

rules.name: The Modes Not Overrides Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is the second mode of the same semantic tokens under `data-theme='dark'`. No `dark:` utilities, no literal colours, no hand-added tokens; a value the blueprint lacks goes in `supplement.css` as a request to design.

rules.name: The Look Is Not the Level Rule
rules.body: `Text` takes a `variant` for how it looks and `as` for what it is; the heading outline follows the page, never the type scale.

rules.name: The Handwriting Is a Person Rule
rules.body: Caveat is only ever a person's aside or something written by hand. A margin note (HandwrittenNote) is in orange, tilted 3 degrees, and hidden from assistive technology, so it never carries anything the page needs; on a Home card the large handwriting takes its card kind's ink instead.

rules.name: The Paper Lifts, the Page Stays Rule
rules.body: The page and list cards are flat; only what floats (a dialog, a postcard, a glass card) or lies on paper (a stamp) casts a shadow.

dos: Do reach for semantic tokens and the atoms (`Text`, `Button`, `Badge`, `StatusText`, `Card`, `Postmark`) before writing a class; every utility is token-backed.
Do give an act its hue: plum for the product and giving, blue for anything asked and #hashtags, orange for a person's voice, @mentions and Kudos.
Do say a status as a word in the `-active` shade (`StatusText`, `Text` tones), and use the `-fg` shades only on that status's tinted surface.
Do set headings in Cooper through the display variants, and pick `as` for the outline separately from `variant` for the look.
Do use the `warning` button for a reversible ending such as Sign out, and `danger` only for a loss.
Do reuse postcard stock, the Postmark and the stamp for paper moments, and let paper sit a degree or two off square.
Do make every motion collapse to its end state under reduced motion.
donts: Don't write `dark:` utilities or literal colours; dark mode is a token mode under `data-theme='dark'`.
Don't hand-add tokens to `packages/tokens`; change the blueprint and regenerate, or request a supplement.
Don't use a `-fg` status shade for text on the page; it reads near-black there.
Don't write a margin note (HandwrittenNote) in any colour but orange, or use orange for a product action that is not a person's own.
Don't let handwriting carry information the page needs; it is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
Don't set an uppercase overline above a heading as a kicker; overlines label a field or a nav group.
Don't add a box shadow to list cards or Settings cards; they are flat on their ground.
